questions.text: A 20 kWp commercial solar installation in Davao (5.2 kWh/m2/day, PR 0.80) generates 30,368 kWh/year. The system cost is 8.5 million PHP. Over a 25-year lifespan, considering 0.7% annual panel degradation, 1% annual O&M cost, a 5% discount rate, and electricity rate of 12 PHP/kWh (assumed constant), what is the approximate Net Present Value (NPV) of the investment?

options.text: A) Negative (approximately -4.9 million PHP, in the -2.0 to -5.0 million PHP range); investment is not justified on pure economics without tariff escalation or incentives
B) Slightly positive (0.5 to 1.5 million PHP); marginal investment with moderate risk
C) Substantially positive (4.0 to 6.0 million PHP); strong investment with high confidence
D) Cannot be determined without knowing the inflation rate and future electricity tariff changes

questions.rationale: Year 1 energy revenue = 30,368 kWh x 12 PHP/kWh = 364,416 PHP. Apply 0.7%/year degradation and discount at 5% over 25 years: PV of degraded energy savings = sum_{t=1..25} [30,368 x (0.993)^(t-1) x 12 / (1.05)^t] = 4,809,387 PHP (geometric series with ratio r = 0.993/1.05 = 0.9457; sum = (1 - 0.9457^25) / (1 - 0.9457) x 30,368 x 12 / 1.05). Annuity factor at 5% for 25 years = (1 - 1.05^(-25))/0.05 = 14.094. PV of O&M = 85,000 PHP/year x 14.094 = 1,197,985 PHP. NPV = PV_savings - Capex - PV_OM = 4,809,387 - 8,500,000 - 1,197,985 = -4,888,599 PHP (approximately -4.9M PHP, negative). Correct answer is a. The originally marked answer c (+4 to +6M PHP positive) would require an unstated tariff escalation of approximately 5-7%/year, contradicting the stem's explicit 'assumed constant' wording. Option d is incorrect because the stem explicitly fixes all NPV inputs.

questions.text: In PEC terminology, what is a PV output circuit?

options.text: The utility service drop serving the building.
The circuit from the PV source-circuit connection point to the inverter or dc utilization equipment.
The final branch circuit serving lighting outlets.
The grounding electrode conductor for the service.

questions.rationale: The circuit from the PV source-circuit connection point to the inverter or dc utilization equipment. This answer matches PEC refined markdown lines 29231-29720.
